job.title: Consumer and belief intelligence analyst/ Lead - Digital & Comms Agency
job.description:
Newly created and unique opportunity to join a thriving PR/Comms agency!
You will be involved in helping their vast and varied client base and governments navigate complex issues and manage reputational risk and shape public beliefs.
  
You will monitor, analyse, and interpret emerging patterns in social discourse, online behaviour, and your stakeholders perceptions.
  
You will generate concise reports to inform strategic decisions, including intelligence analysis.
  
You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify risks, opportunities, and actionable insights and deliver data-driven strategies at pace.
  
In short this role is part analyst, part detective, part strategist.
They are excited to see what insights you can deliver and bring to the table, and spotting what isn’t obvious and what others can’t!
  
This is a truly unique role to carve out for yourself, with definite career progression and the opportunity to potentially build out your own team down the line.

  • £80k-£100k + benefits
  • Ideally 4 days in the London office
  • ASAP start but can be flexible and wait notice periods

  • Run the Conversation and Behaviour analysis across client work and your own market intelligence.
  • This means social listening (done properly) monitoring online behaviour and analysis that turns thousands of raw signals into something the board will act on.
  • You will work with AI throughout on the custom made AI platform, ensuring accuracy and catch any errors. AI will do the groundwork, you must do the thinking.
  • Run social listening across X, Reddit, Telegram, LinkedIn, forums, review sites, and employee voice platforms such as Glassdoor and Blind. (Ensure you separate real signal from bots and noise
  • AI visibility work- track online behaviour and trends
  • Build and apply classification rules, ensuring analysis is consistent in regardless to whoever is running it (so it holds up when a client challenges it)
  • Run the internal tools AI pipeline, ensuring quality on every output, and flag anything that does not stand up.
  • Turn findings into clear written insights,
  • Help build and present Belief Assessments and Belief Gap analysis and ongoing intelligence work, including partnering with clients and presenting.
The person:
  • Experience in social listening and online behavioural understanding and research, and experience with tools such as Brandwatch, Meltwater, Pulsar, Talkwalker, Sprinklr etc
  • Strong with both numbers and narrative, the ability to look at trends and analyse
  • Understand how a story moves across X, Reddit, and Telegram i
  • A confident  user of AI tools (you don't need to be a specialist yet)
  • Search, SEO, or GEO (AI visibility) experience.
  • Possible backgrounds include corporate communications, public affairs, research, planning, or agency strategy.

  • Comfort in handling large datasets and utilising AI-powered tools for insights
  • Ability to work collaboratively in an interdisciplinary and fast-paced environment
  • Experience in strategy or data-driven campaign planning is a plus
  • A degree in data science or similar is useful

job.title: Marketing Associate (owned)
job.description:
We’re working with a fast-growing, social-first consumer business that has built a huge audience through organic content and is now looking for a Marketing Associate to join its Owned Marketing team.
This isn’t a traditional social content role. It’s about using content as a testing engine, combining creative instinct with performance data to decide what gets scaled.

This is a great opportunity for someone early in their career who understands social and content, but is also interested in the why behind performance.
You’ll be someone who enjoys spotting trends and creative opportunities, testing different ideas and using results to understand what is worth scaling.
You’ll join a small, high-performing team responsible for creating, testing and distributing content across the brand’s own channels. The focus isn’t simply on making content. It’s about testing creative before launch, learning from performance and using those insights to improve the chances of a product succeeding.

What you’ll be doing

• Owning the pre-launch content testing process for new product releases, developing different creative angles and formats to understand what resonates before wider marketing investment is committed..
• Coming up with creative concepts based on social trends, audience behaviour and what you know works across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube and Facebook..
• Creating and filming short-form content, then working with in-house video editors to develop and test multiple versions..
• Publishing and distributing content across the brand’s owned social channels..
• Tracking performance against agreed benchmarks and identifying what is working, what isn’t and why..
• Using performance insights to make clear recommendations on which creative angles, formats and products should be scaled, developed or deprioritised..
• Managing content production from brief through to delivery, including briefing, casting, filming and directing editors..
• Working closely with the wider marketing team to turn learnings from testing into future content and launch plans..
• Supporting ongoing content creation around key products, launches and retail partnerships..

Who we’re looking for

We’re looking for someone who sits between creative content and performance marketing.
You might have 1–2 years’ experience in social, content, creative strategy, growth marketing or a similar role, or you could be earlier in your career with strong evidence of hands-on experience and commercial thinking.

What matters most is that you can demonstrate:

• A strong understanding of what makes content work on social, and an interest in understanding why..
• Experience creating content for TikTok, Instagram, YouTube or similar platforms..
• An ability to spot trends, develop creative ideas and turn them into content quickly..
• A structured approach to testing different creative angles rather than simply creating content and hoping it performs..
• Confidence looking at performance data and turning it into clear, practical learnings..
• Good commercial judgement and curiosity around what makes a product or piece of content succeed..
• The initiative to take an idea from concept through to execution..
• A hands-on attitude and willingness to get involved in filming, production and publishing..
Experience in DTC, ecommerce, gaming, entertainment or another fast-moving consumer business would be particularly relevant, but isn’t essential.

Why consider it?

This is a genuinely hands-on role where you’ll have the opportunity to see the direct impact of your work.
Rather than simply producing content against a brief, you’ll be involved in testing ideas, analysing what happens and helping decide what gets taken forward. You’ll work closely with an entrepreneurial marketing team, have real ownership from an early stage and learn quickly as the business continues to grow.
There is significant autonomy, creative freedom and scope to progress with the business.

Benefits
• £30,000–£40,000 depending on experience.
• 25 days’ annual leave plus bank holidays.
• Hybrid working, with four days per week in a central London office and one day from home.
• Pension scheme.
• Regular team lunches, breakfasts and socials.
• Fully stocked office kitchen.
• Product allowance.


If you’re looking to build a career in social and marketing and want the opportunity to take real ownership early, we’d love to hear from you.

job.description:

If you're interested in being contacted about roles similar to the opportunity outlined below, we'd love to hear from you. Please apply with your latest CV, and a member of our team will be in touch if we have a suitable opportunity that matches your experience and career goals.


Social & Cultural Insights Analyst
Location: London
Working pattern: Hybrid
Environment: Creative / Social Agency

About the Role
We're looking for a curious and culturally plugged-in Social & Cultural Insights Analyst to join a growing creative agency.
This is an agency-side role for someone who is fascinated by what people are talking about, how culture is changing and what those shifts mean for brands.
You'll combine social listening, data, research and cultural trends to uncover insights that help shape client strategy, creative ideas and campaigns. You'll work closely with strategists, creatives and account teams, helping turn data and cultural intelligence into clear, actionable thinking for clients.

Key Responsibilities
  • Monitor social platforms, online communities, media and cultural conversations to identify emerging trends, behaviours and cultural movements
  • Use social listening, analytics and research tools to understand audiences, sentiment, conversations and cultural shifts
  • Analyse social and consumer data and translate findings into clear, actionable insights for clients
  • Identify emerging cultural moments and trends that could be relevant to brands and audiences
  • Create reports, presentations and dashboards to communicate key findings and recommendations
  • Support strategic and creative development through research and insight
  • Partner with strategists and creative teams to ensure ideas are culturally relevant and grounded in audience understanding
  • Monitor brand and competitor conversations across social and digital channels
  • Analyse campaign performance and social/cultural impact, identifying opportunities for optimisation
  • Present insights and recommendations clearly to both internal teams and clients
  • Stay constantly curious about social media, online communities, consumer behaviour and wider culture


About You
We're interested in candidates with 3+ years' experience across areas such as:
  • Social Insights
  • Cultural Insights / Cultural Strategy
  • Social Listening
  • Consumer Insights
  • Audience Intelligence
  • Social Analytics
  • Data & Insights
  • Trend Research


You'll ideally have:
  • Experience working within an agency, consultancy or similar client-facing environment
  • Experience using social listening or analytics platforms such as Brandwatch, Talkwalker, Sprinklr, NetBase or similar
  • A strong understanding of social media and digital culture
  • Excellent research and analytical skills
  • The ability to turn data and research into clear, compelling insights
  • A genuine curiosity about culture, trends, audiences and consumer behaviour
  • Strong communication and presentation skills
  • Confidence working with clients and presenting insight
  • The ability to collaborate closely with strategy, creative and account teams
  • A balance of analytical and creative thinking


The Opportunity
This is an opportunity to join a fast-paced creative agency and work across a range of brands and briefs.
You'll have the opportunity to influence client strategy and creative thinking by bringing a strong understanding of social, culture, trends and consumer behaviour to the table.
If you're someone who is constantly spotting the next trend, questioning why people behave the way they do and enjoys turning data into a story, we'd love to hear from you.

London | Hybrid | Creative Agency

job.title: Client Partner (Digital)
job.description:
Client Partner
London | Hybrid | Permanent

We’re looking for a senior Client Partner to lead and grow a major global technology account for an established digital consultancy.

This is a senior commercial and relationship-led role, focused on deepening an existing client partnership and expanding the business into new teams, markets and areas of need. There is already a strong relationship and significant delivery activity in place, so the opportunity is less about winning a client from scratch and more about identifying where else the consultancy can add value and converting that into sustainable account growth.

The role
You’ll own senior client relationships and work closely with multidisciplinary internal teams to identify, shape and develop new opportunities.

Typical work sold into the client includes:
  • Digital products, platforms, apps and websites
  • AI-enabled solutions
  • Digital strategy and innovation programmes
  • Early-stage concepts and pilots
  • Customer experience and service challenges
  • Longer-term delivery and specialist team support
Projects can range from shorter strategic engagements through to multi-month delivery programmes and longer-term retained or embedded support.
A major part of the role is growing the account across a complex global organisation: building relationships with new stakeholders, understanding the priorities of different teams and identifying where the consultancy’s capabilities can solve meaningful business problems.

You’ll also take ownership of the commercial health of the account, including pipeline visibility, forecasting, opportunity qualification and early commercial conversations. You’ll be expected to shape initial approaches, team requirements and indicative costs, with specialist teams supporting detailed scoping and delivery.

What we’re looking for
We’re interested in people who have:
  • Led and grown a significant enterprise client within a digital agency, consultancy, innovation business or related environment
  • Successfully expanded an existing relationship into new business units, markets or teams
  • Worked with large, complex global organisations
  • Sold digital, technology, experience, innovation or transformation services
  • Strong senior stakeholder management and relationship-building skills
  • Commercial experience across pipeline, forecasting, costing and account growth
  • The ability to identify opportunities, turn them into credible client conversations and bring the right people together internally
  • Experience working alongside multidisciplinary strategy, creative, technology and delivery teams
The person
This will suit someone ambitious, commercially minded and comfortable operating in a collaborative environment.
You’ll need the resilience and tenacity to keep developing relationships and creating opportunities when progress is not always immediate, while staying focused on delivering strong outcomes for both the client and the business.

Location
Hybrid London role, with regular time in the office. Some international travel will also be required as part of the global client relationship.

job.title: MW Art Director - Freelance
job.description:
Midweight Art Director - Freelance

London | £350-£400 per day | Inside IR35 | 3 days onsite / 2 days WFH

Start date Oct/ Nov - Maternity cover - long contract 3 months with an option to extend to a year. 

My client is looking for a Midweight Art Director with big ideas, great craft and the ability to make things happen.

This is an opportunity to join a brilliant creative team and work across a wide mix of integrated briefs, creating ideas that don't just look good on a page, they actually get made.

You'll be someone who can take a brief, find the interesting bit, and turn it into a strong, scalable creative idea that works across channels.

You might work alongside a Copywriter, collaborate with Designers and Motion Designers, or take a brief away and run with it yourself. Either way, you'll be expected to bring plenty of creative energy, strong art direction and a genuine desire to make the work better.

What you'll be doing
  • Developing big, integrated creative ideas that answer the brief and can flex across different channels.
  • Creating a range of strong concepts to present to Creative Directors and wider teams.
  • Taking ideas from initial scamps through to polished execution.
  • Working closely with Copywriters, Designers, Motion Designers, Planners and Creative Directors.
  • Understanding what makes an idea work across different channels and adapting it accordingly.
  • Bringing strong art direction and visual craft to every project.
  • Presenting and selling your ideas with confidence.
  • Getting involved in everything from big campaigns and pitches to smaller day-to-day briefs — with the same level of enthusiasm.
  • Working with designers and production teams to bring your vision to life.
  • Getting involved in shoots and understanding what it takes to turn an idea into great finished work.
  • Using AI intelligently where it can genuinely improve the creative process.
  • Keeping up with new platforms, technology, creative trends and cultural shifts.
  • Challenging briefs and feedback when you think there's a better creative solution — always constructively.
  • Delivering great work on time, on brief and within budget.
About you

We're looking for an Art Director who is conceptual at heart but knows how to execute.
You'll have:
  • Solid experience as a Midweight Art Director within a reputable creative or advertising agency.
  • A portfolio packed with ideas that have genuinely been made.
  • Strong integrated thinking — you understand how to take an idea beyond a single channel.
  • Excellent art direction and visual craft.
  • The ability to work independently, as well as alongside a Copywriter.
  • Confidence presenting your ideas and explaining the thinking behind them.
  • A commercial understanding of how creative work gets delivered.
  • A collaborative attitude and zero ego — you enjoy working with different disciplines and making the overall work better.
  • Good knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite.
  • An understanding of how AI can be used practically and creatively.
  • A passion for the industry and a curiosity about what's happening next.
The important bit

We're looking for someone who sees a freelance role as more than just the next gig.

Someone who throws themselves into the work, whether it's a huge campaign, a pitch or a small brief that needs cracking. Someone who cares about the detail, wants to make great work and is happy to roll up their sleeves to get there.

If that sounds like you, we'd love to see your book.

job.title: Production Lead / EP - Inhouse content Studio
job.description:
Production Lead / Executive Producer - Europe for a leading inhouse content studio

This will be a 12 month freelance role starting in January 2027
Inside IR35
3 days a week in the office - London
c£500 a day
 
We are looking for an entrepreneurial Production Lead or Executive Producer to establish and lead a modern production capability across Europe for an in-house content studio. 
 
This is a newly created role with a clear mandate: to identify the most effective production solution for every project, balancing quality, speed, creativity and cost.
 
The Production Lead will be the central point of leadership for production, determining the right approach for each project and deciding when work is best delivered through an internal studio, freelance talent, production partners or external suppliers.

Key Responsibilities
  • Build and shape the organisation's production capability, operating model and ways of working.
  • Define the most effective production approach for each campaign, content and digital project.
  • Develop and manage a strong network of production partners, freelancers and specialist suppliers across the UK and Europe.
  • Lead productions from initial planning through to final delivery, ensuring high-quality, efficient and commercially effective execution.
  • Manage production budgets, timelines, resources and risks.
  • Partner closely with creative, account and client teams, providing expert guidance on production strategy and delivery.
  • Identify opportunities to improve production processes, efficiency and scalability.
  • Lead, support and develop a Content Producer
  • Scope of work: Work spans always-on social, paid social craft, smaller productions, and larger external productions. Examples include mobilizing videographers, set designers, prop or art departments, animatronics specialists, 3D printers, and other local suppliers for work in markets such as Rome, Porto, Berlin and Spain.
What We're Looking For
  • Extensive experience as a Production Lead or in a comparable senior production role with a Production company background or AND social agency experience 
  • Strong experience across content and social (social first experience ideal)
  • Proven ability to build production frameworks, supplier networks and effective ways of working from the ground up. Supplier and freelancer network across European markets
  • Excellent problem-solving, planning and decision-making skills.
  • An established network of production contacts across the UK and Europe.
  • A strong commercial mindset, with the ability to balance creative ambition, quality, timelines and budget.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, evolving environment and building new capabilities from the ground up.
  • A collaborative and entrepreneurial approach, with the confidence to influence senior stakeholders and shape how production is delivered.
What Success Looks Like
  • Establishing a scalable and effective production model across Europe.
  • Building a trusted network of high-quality production partners, freelancers and suppliers.
  • Improving production quality, speed and cost efficiency.
  • Ensuring each project is delivered through the most appropriate and commercially effective production solution.
  • Creating a flexible production model that can adapt to changing project needs and creative ambition.
  • Establishing the organisation as a leader in modern, agile and efficient content production.
We're looking for someone who doesn't simply manage productions, but designs the system behind them — creating a smarter, more flexible and scalable approach to production.
